def update_web_control(**kwargs: Any) -> None:
    """Cap nhat control tu web Page 1: AUTO/MANU + 5 manual sliders."""
    with _CONTROL_LOCK:
        for key, value in kwargs.items():
            if key == "mode":
                mode = str(value).upper().strip()
                if mode in ("AUTO", "MANU"):
                    _CONTROL["mode"] = mode
            elif key == "palm_test_toggle":
                try:
                    if bool(value):
                        _CONTROL["palm_test_toggle_seq"] = int(_CONTROL.get("palm_test_toggle_seq", 0)) + 1
                except Exception:
                    _CONTROL["palm_test_toggle_seq"] = int(_CONTROL.get("palm_test_toggle_seq", 0)) + 1
            elif key in ("reset_to_tracking", "reset_object_latch", "reset_to_hand_tracking"):
                try:
                    if bool(value):
                        _CONTROL["mode"] = "AUTO"
                        _CONTROL["reset_to_tracking_seq"] = int(_CONTROL.get("reset_to_tracking_seq", 0) or 0) + 1
                except Exception:
                    _CONTROL["mode"] = "AUTO"
                    _CONTROL["reset_to_tracking_seq"] = int(_CONTROL.get("reset_to_tracking_seq", 0) or 0) + 1
            elif key == "servo_pulse_override_enabled":
                _CONTROL["servo_pulse_override_enabled"] = bool(value)
                if not bool(value):
                    # Turning A/OFF clears all pending direct pulse commands.
                    for _f in ("thumb", "index", "middle", "ring", "pinky"):
                        _CONTROL[f"servo_pulse_{_f}_us"] = 0
            elif key.startswith("servo_pulse_") and key.endswith("_us"):
                # Accept only 400..2500 us, same hard limit as ESP32 attach/clamp range.
                try:
                    us = int(float(value))
                    us = max(400, min(2500, us))
                    _CONTROL[key] = us
                    # Increase per-finger sequence so Python knows this is a new apply command.
                    _f = key[len("servo_pulse_"):-len("_us")]
                    seq_key = f"servo_pulse_{_f}_seq"
                    if seq_key in _CONTROL:
                        _CONTROL[seq_key] = int(_CONTROL.get(seq_key, 0) or 0) + 1
                except Exception:
                    pass
            elif key.startswith("manual_") and key.endswith("_pct"):
                try:
                    _CONTROL[key] = max(0.0, min(100.0, float(value)))
                except Exception:
                    pass
        _CONTROL["last_update"] = time.time()


def get_web_control_snapshot() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Python main loop goi ham nay de lay lenh MANU tu web."""
    with _CONTROL_LOCK:
        return deepcopy(_CONTROL)


_CAMERA_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_CAMERA_JPEG = {"main": None, "phone": None}
_CAMERA_TS = {"main": 0.0, "phone": 0.0}


def update_camera_jpeg(name: str, jpeg_bytes: bytes) -> None:
    """
    Cap nhat frame camera dang JPEG bytes cho web.
    name: "main" hoac "phone".
    """
    if name not in _CAMERA_JPEG:
        return
    if not jpeg_bytes:
        return
    with _CAMERA_LOCK:
        _CAMERA_JPEG[name] = bytes(jpeg_bytes)
        _CAMERA_TS[name] = time.time()


def update_camera_frame(name: str, frame_bgr, quality: int = 70, max_width: int = 960) -> None:
    """
    Cap nhat camera tu frame OpenCV BGR.
    Goi ham nay trong main loop sau khi da ve YOLO box/landmark len frame.

    Vi du:
        update_camera_frame("main", frame_main_display)
        update_camera_frame("phone", frame_phone_display)
    """
    if name not in _CAMERA_JPEG:
        return
    if frame_bgr is None:
        return

    try:
        import cv2
    except Exception:
        return

    try:
        frame = frame_bgr
        h, w = frame.shape[:2]
        if max_width and w > max_width:
            scale = max_width / float(w)
            frame = cv2.resize(frame, (int(w * scale), int(h * scale)), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
        ok, buf = cv2.imencode(".jpg", frame, [int(cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY), int(quality)])
        if ok:
            update_camera_jpeg(name, buf.tobytes())
    except Exception:
        return


def _placeholder_svg(name: str) -> bytes:
    title = "MAIN CAMERA" if name == "main" else "PHONE CAMERA"
    svg = f"""<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='960' height='540' viewBox='0 0 960 540'>
<defs><linearGradient id='g' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'><stop offset='0' stop-color='#07111f'/><stop offset='1' stop-color='#0f1b31'/></linearGradient></defs>
<rect width='960' height='540' fill='url(#g)'/>
<rect x='24' y='24' width='912' height='492' rx='28' fill='#050914' stroke='#1f3b55' stroke-width='2'/>
<text x='50%' y='47%' text-anchor='middle' fill='#22d3ee' font-family='Arial' font-size='36' font-weight='700'>{title}</text>
<text x='50%' y='56%' text-anchor='middle' fill='#91a4be' font-family='Arial' font-size='20'>Waiting for Python frame...</text>
</svg>"""
    return svg.encode("utf-8")


def get_camera_response(name: str):
    """Tra ve tuple (data, content_type) cho endpoint camera."""
    if name not in _CAMERA_JPEG:
        return _placeholder_svg(name), "image/svg+xml; charset=utf-8"
    with _CAMERA_LOCK:
        data = _CAMERA_JPEG.get(name)
    if data is None:
        return _placeholder_svg(name), "image/svg+xml; charset=utf-8"
    return data, "image/jpeg"

def _read_local_image_response(path: str, fallback_label: str):
    """Đọc ảnh local và trả về (bytes, content_type)."""
    mime_map = {
        ".png": "image/png",
        ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
        ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
        ".webp": "image/webp",
        ".svg": "image/svg+xml; charset=utf-8",
    }

    try:
        p = os.path.expandvars(os.path.expanduser(str(path or "").strip().strip('"')))
        if p and os.path.isfile(p):
            ext = os.path.splitext(p)[1].lower()
            content_type = mime_map.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
            with open(p, "rb") as f:
                return f.read(), content_type
    except Exception:
        pass

    return _logo_fallback_svg(fallback_label), "image/svg+xml; charset=utf-8"


def get_logo_response(kind: str):
    """Route ảnh logo header: /api/logo/school và /api/logo/faculty."""
    kind = str(kind or "").strip().lower()
    if kind == "faculty":
        return _read_local_image_response(FACULTY_LOGO_PATH, "FEEE")
    return _read_local_image_response(SCHOOL_LOGO_PATH, "HCMUTE")

def _find_ngrok_exe(ngrok_path: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Tim ngrok.exe de tu tao public link.
    Uu tien:
    - tham so ngrok_path
    - bien moi truong NGROK_PATH
    - file ngrok.exe nam cung thu muc voi file .py nay
    - ngrok trong PATH Windows
    """
    candidates = []

    if ngrok_path:
        candidates.append(ngrok_path)

    env_path = os.environ.get("NGROK_PATH", "").strip()
    if env_path:
        candidates.append(env_path)

    try:
        here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
        candidates.append(os.path.join(here, "ngrok.exe"))
        candidates.append(os.path.join(here, "ngrok"))
    except Exception:
        pass

    which_ngrok = shutil.which("ngrok") or shutil.which("ngrok.exe")
    if which_ngrok:
        candidates.append(which_ngrok)

    # Thu them vai vi tri Windows hay dung
    candidates.extend([
        r"D:\ngrok\ngrok.exe",
        r"C:\ngrok\ngrok.exe",
        os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "Downloads", "ngrok.exe"),
        os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "Desktop", "ngrok.exe"),
    ])

    for item in candidates:
        if not item:
            continue
        item = os.path.expandvars(os.path.expanduser(str(item).strip().strip('"')))
        if os.path.isfile(item):
            return item

    return None


def _read_ngrok_public_url() -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Doc URL public tu local API cua ngrok: http://127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels
    Tra ve link https neu co.
    """
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels", timeout=0.8) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
        data = json.loads(raw)
        tunnels = data.get("tunnels", [])
        public_urls = []
        for t in tunnels:
            url = str(t.get("public_url", "")).strip()
            if url:
                public_urls.append(url)

        # Uu tien HTTPS de gui cho nguoi khac
        for url in public_urls:
            if url.startswith("https://"):
                return url
        return public_urls[0] if public_urls else None
    except Exception:
        return None


def start_public_tunnel_ngrok(
    port: int = 5000,
    ngrok_path: Optional[str] = None,
    print_link: bool = True,
    wait_sec: float = 8.0,
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Tu bat ngrok va lay public URL.
    Cach dung:
        start_web_dashboard(port=5000, public=True)

    Dieu kien:
    - May da co ngrok.exe
    - Da chay: ngrok config add-authtoken TOKEN_CUA_BAN
    """
    global _NGROK_PROCESS, _NGROK_PUBLIC_URL

    # Neu ngrok da co tunnel dang chay o may, doc lai URL luon.
    old_url = _read_ngrok_public_url()
    if old_url:
        _NGROK_PUBLIC_URL = old_url
        if print_link:
            print("=" * 86)
            print(f"[PUBLIC WEB] Public URL dang chay: {_NGROK_PUBLIC_URL}")
            print("[PUBLIC WEB] Gui link nay cho ban o ngoai mang de xem realtime.")
            print("=" * 86)
        return _NGROK_PUBLIC_URL

    exe = _find_ngrok_exe(ngrok_path)
    if not exe:
        if print_link:
            print("[PUBLIC WEB] Chua tim thay ngrok.exe nen chua tu tao link public duoc.")
            print_public_tunnel_help(port)
        return None

    try:
        _NGROK_PROCESS = subprocess.Popen(
            [exe, "http", str(port)],
            stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW if os.name == "nt" else 0,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        if print_link:
            print(f"[PUBLIC WEB] Khong mo duoc ngrok: {e}")
            print_public_tunnel_help(port)
        return None

    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < wait_sec:
        url = _read_ngrok_public_url()
        if url:
            _NGROK_PUBLIC_URL = url
            if print_link:
                print("=" * 86)
                print("[PUBLIC WEB] Da tao link NGOAI MANG thanh cong.")
                print(f"[PUBLIC WEB] Gui link nay cho ban o truong: {_NGROK_PUBLIC_URL}")
                print("[PUBLIC WEB] Luu y: khong tat terminal Python / khong tat ngrok.")
                print("=" * 86)
            return _NGROK_PUBLIC_URL
        time.sleep(0.35)

    if print_link:
        print("[PUBLIC WEB] Da mo ngrok nhung chua doc duoc public URL.")
        print("[PUBLIC WEB] Co the ban chua add authtoken hoac ngrok dang loi.")
        print_public_tunnel_help(port)
    return None


def get_public_url() -> Optional[str]:
    """Lay public URL hien tai neu ngrok dang chay."""
    global _NGROK_PUBLIC_URL
    url = _read_ngrok_public_url()
    if url:
        _NGROK_PUBLIC_URL = url
    return _NGROK_PUBLIC_URL



def get_local_ip() -> str:
    """
    Lay IP LAN that cua laptop de dien thoai cung Wi-Fi truy cap.
    Uu tien IP 192.168.x.x / 10.x.x.x / 172.16-31.x.x.
    Bo qua cac IP la nhu 127.x.x.x, 169.254.x.x, 0.x.x.x va adapter ao.
    """
    candidates = []

    # Cach 1: lay IP tu hostname
    try:
        host_name = socket.gethostname()
        infos = socket.getaddrinfo(host_name, None, family=socket.AF_INET)
        for item in infos:
            ip = item[4][0]
            candidates.append(ip)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Cach 2: mo UDP socket de he dieu hanh chon route mac dinh
    # Khong gui goi tin that ra internet, chi de lay local address.
    for target in [("8.8.8.8", 80), ("1.1.1.1", 80), ("192.168.1.1", 80)]:
        try:
            s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
            s.settimeout(0.2)
            s.connect(target)
            candidates.append(s.getsockname()[0])
            s.close()
        except Exception:
            try:
                s.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def is_good_lan_ip(ip: str) -> bool:
        parts = ip.split(".")
        if len(parts) != 4:
            return False
        try:
            a, b, c, d = [int(x) for x in parts]
        except Exception:
            return False

        # Bo qua local/loi/adapter ao
        if a in (0, 127):
            return False
        if a == 169 and b == 254:
            return False
        if d == 0 or d == 255:
            return False

        # Uu tien LAN private
        if a == 192 and b == 168:
            return True
        if a == 10:
            return True
        if a == 172 and 16 <= b <= 31:
            return True

        return False

    # Bo trung lap nhung giu thu tu
    unique = []
    for ip in candidates:
        if ip not in unique:
            unique.append(ip)

    for ip in unique:
        if is_good_lan_ip(ip):
            return ip

    # Neu khong tim duoc, tra ve hostname de nguoi dung thu http://LAPTOP-HAO:5000
    try:
        return socket.gethostname()
    except Exception:
        return "127.0.0.1"


def get_access_links(port: int = 5000) -> dict:
    """
    Tra ve cac link de hien thi ra terminal:
    - local: mo tren chinh laptop
    - hostname: mo bang ten may, vi du http://LAPTOP-HAO:5000
    - lan: mo bang IP LAN, chac an nhat neu dien thoai cung Wi-Fi
    """
    try:
        host_name = socket.gethostname()
    except Exception:
        host_name = "LAPTOP-HAO"

    lan_ip = get_local_ip()

    return {
        "local": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}",
        "hostname": f"http://{host_name}:{port}",
        "hostname_local": f"http://{host_name}.local:{port}",
        "lan": f"http://{lan_ip}:{port}",
        "lan_ip": lan_ip,
        "host_name": host_name,
    }


def update_dashboard(**kwargs: Any) -> None:
    """
    Cap nhat du lieu hien thi dashboard.
    Goi ham nay trong main loop cua code Python chinh.
    """
    with _STATUS_LOCK:
        for key, value in kwargs.items():
            _STATUS[key] = value
        _STATUS["last_update"] = time.time()


def get_dashboard_snapshot() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    with _STATUS_LOCK:
        return deepcopy(_STATUS)

    /* ===================== V36 SERVO PULSE TEST PANEL - A SHOWS ALWAYS ===================== */
    .pulse-panel-wrap{position:relative;z-index:3;margin:7px 0 0 0;max-width:392px;width:392px}
    .pulse-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:24px;padding:3px 5px;border:1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.18);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(2,6,23,.26);max-width:392px}
    .pulse-a{width:28px;height:22px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.36);background:rgba(34,211,238,.10);color:#67e8f9;font-size:11px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer;line-height:1}.pulse-a.on{border-color:rgba(245,158,11,.70);background:rgba(245,158,11,.16);color:#fcd34d}.pulse-a:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.45}
    .pulse-title{font-size:8.8px;font-weight:1000;color:#e6f4ff;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.09em;white-space:nowrap}.pulse-gate{margin-left:auto;font-size:8.8px;font-weight:1000;color:#fcd34d;white-space:nowrap}.pulse-gate.open{color:#86efac}.pulse-gate.off{color:#94a3b8}
    .pulse-panel{display:none;margin-top:4px;border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.13);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(2,6,23,.33);padding:4px 5px;max-width:392px;width:392px}.pulse-panel.show{display:grid;gap:2px}.pulse-panel.locked{cursor:not-allowed}
    .pulse-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:49px 43px 50px 37px 61px 28px;gap:4px;align-items:center;min-height:21px;font-size:8.8px;font-weight:900;color:#dbeafe;white-space:nowrap}.pulse-row b{font-size:9px;color:#e7f4ff}.pulse-row .pct{color:#67e8f9;text-align:right}.pulse-row .us{color:#fcd34d;text-align:right}.pulse-row .label{color:#91a4be;text-align:right}.pulse-row input{width:61px;height:20px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.25);background:rgba(15,23,42,.85);color:#e6f4ff;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:900;text-align:center;outline:none}.pulse-row input:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}.pulse-row button{width:28px;height:20px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.34);background:rgba(34,211,238,.10);color:#67e8f9;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:1000;cursor:pointer}.pulse-row button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed}.pulse-lock-note{display:none;color:#fcd34d;font-size:8.2px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.1;padding:1px 2px 2px}.pulse-panel.show.locked .pulse-lock-note{display:block}
