    @media(max-width:1100px){#page2 .exp-top-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}#page2 .exp-main-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}#page2 .exp-current-body{grid-template-columns:1fr}#page2 .exp-chart-body{grid-template-columns:1fr}#page2 .exp-metric-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}#page2 .exp-led-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}

    /* ===================== V51: PAGE 2 COMPACT FOR UNITY SPLIT-SCREEN =====================
       Keep the experiment dashboard inside the same presentation footprint as
       Page 1.  All measurements remain visible; the app itself scrolls when
       the table extends below the viewport, leaving the right side for Unity.
    */
    body.exp-mode .app{
      width:min(900px,calc(100vw - 16px))!important;
      max-width:900px!important;
      padding:0 6px 14px 0!important;
    }
    body.exp-mode .topbar{
      min-height:44px!important;
      padding:6px 10px!important;
      border-radius:12px!important;
    }
    body.exp-mode .tabs{margin-top:7px!important}
    body.exp-mode .tabbtn{
      min-width:0!important;
      min-height:32px!important;
      padding:6px 12px!important;
      border-radius:10px!important;
      font-size:10px!important;
    }

    #page2 .exp-wrap{gap:7px!important}
    #page2 .exp-top-grid{
      grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
      gap:6px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-card{
      min-height:54px!important;
      padding:8px 9px!important;
      gap:7px!important;
      border-radius:11px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-ico{
      width:24px!important;
      height:24px!important;
      font-size:19px!important;
      flex:0 0 24px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-k{font-size:8.5px!important;letter-spacing:.05em!important}
    #page2 .exp-v{font-size:17px!important;margin-top:3px!important;white-space:nowrap}

    #page2 .exp-led-row{
      grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
      gap:6px!important;
      max-width:100%!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-led{
      height:30px!important;
      gap:7px!important;
      border-radius:10px!important;
      font-size:10px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-led i{width:10px!important;height:10px!important}

    #page2 .exp-main-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:7px!important}
    #page2 .exp-panel{border-radius:12px!important}
    #page2 .exp-panel-title{
      padding:9px 10px 5px!important;
      font-size:13px!important;
      letter-spacing:.03em!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-current-body{
      padding:5px 10px 10px!important;
      grid-template-columns:108px minmax(0,1fr)!important;
      gap:8px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-object-tile{
      min-height:110px!important;
      border-radius:11px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-object-icon{font-size:48px!important}
    #page2 .exp-object-img{max-height:78px!important;max-width:96%!important}
    #page2 .exp-object-emoji{font-size:48px!important}
    #page2 .exp-object-tile b{font-size:16px!important;margin-top:5px!important}
    #page2 .exp-trial-grid{gap:6px!important}
    #page2 .exp-trial{min-height:110px!important;border-radius:11px!important}
    #page2 .exp-trial .t{top:9px!important;left:10px!important;font-size:11px!important}
    #page2 .exp-trial .n{font-size:26px!important}
    #page2 .exp-trial .sub{margin-top:5px!important;font-size:9px!important}

    #page2 .exp-metric-row{
      grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
      margin-top:0!important;
      border-radius:10px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-metric{min-height:54px!important;padding:8px!important}
    #page2 .exp-metric .m-k{font-size:9px!important;white-space:nowrap}
    #page2 .exp-metric .m-v{margin-top:6px!important;font-size:18px!important}

    #page2 .exp-chart-body{
      padding:5px 10px 10px!important;
      grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 175px!important;
      gap:8px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-chart-box{height:182px!important;padding:6px!important;border-radius:10px!important}
    #page2 .exp-side-readout{
      padding:10px!important;
      gap:8px!important;
      border-radius:11px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-side-readout .side-k{font-size:9px!important}
    #page2 .exp-side-readout .side-v{font-size:26px!important}
    #page2 .exp-side-small{font-size:10px!important}
    #page2 .exp-side-small b{font-size:12px!important}

    #page2 .exp-table-panel{padding:9px 10px 8px!important;border-radius:12px!important}
    #page2 .exp-table-title{font-size:13px!important;margin-bottom:7px!important}
    #page2 .exp-table th,#page2 .exp-table td{
      padding:7px 4px!important;
      font-size:9.5px!important;
      line-height:1.15!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-table th{font-size:9px!important}
    #page2 .ok-pill{min-width:48px!important;height:22px!important;font-size:9px!important}
    #page2 .exp-footer-note{font-size:8.5px!important;margin-top:6px!important;gap:6px!important}

    @media(max-width:700px){
      #page2 .exp-top-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
      #page2 .exp-led-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
      #page2 .exp-current-body{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
      #page2 .exp-metric-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
      #page2 .exp-chart-body{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
      #page2 .exp-table{display:block;overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap}
    }

  
    /* ===================== V52: PAGE 2 SUMMARY TABLE READABILITY =====================
       Tăng nhẹ chữ trong bảng Experiment Summary để dễ đọc khi demo split-screen.
       Không đổi logic đo, không đổi dữ liệu realtime.
    */
    #page2 .exp-table-panel{
      padding:10px 11px 9px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-table-title{
      font-size:15.5px!important;
      line-height:1.15!important;
      margin-bottom:9px!important;
      letter-spacing:.045em!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-table{
      table-layout:fixed!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-table th,
    #page2 .exp-table td{
      padding:9px 6px!important;
      font-size:11.4px!important;
      line-height:1.28!important;
      font-weight:900!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-table th{
      font-size:10.6px!important;
      color:#f1f5f9!important;
      letter-spacing:.01em!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-table td:nth-child(2){
      font-size:11.8px!important;
      font-weight:1000!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-table td:nth-child(1){
      width:44px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-table tr{
      min-height:42px!important;
    }
    #page2 .ok-pill{
      min-width:54px!important;
      height:24px!important;
      font-size:10.6px!important;
      font-weight:1000!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-footer-note{
      font-size:9.5px!important;
      line-height:1.25!important;
      margin-top:7px!important;
    }



    /* ===================== V53: PAGE 2 RESET / BACK TO PAGE 1 ===================== */
    #page2 .exp-action-row{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:flex-end;
      align-items:center;
      gap:8px;
      margin-top:-2px;
    }
    #page2 .exp-reset-btn{
      min-height:30px;
      padding:7px 13px;
      border-radius:11px;
      border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.45);
      background:rgba(239,68,68,.12);
      color:#fecaca;
      font-size:10.2px;
      font-weight:1000;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:.045em;
      cursor:pointer;
      box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(239,68,68,.08);
      white-space:nowrap;
    }
    #page2 .exp-reset-btn:hover{
      border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.80);
      background:rgba(239,68,68,.20);
      color:#fff1f2;
    }
    #page2 .exp-reset-btn.secondary{
      border-color:rgba(34,211,238,.42);
      background:rgba(34,211,238,.10);
      color:#67e8f9;
    }
    #page2 .exp-reset-btn.secondary:hover{
      border-color:rgba(34,211,238,.75);
      background:rgba(34,211,238,.18);
      color:#e0faff;
    }


    /* ===================== FIX: FIVE FINGER FORCE ROWS INCLUDING THUMB ===================== */
    #page2 .exp-chart-body{
      grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 235px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-side-readout{
      gap:9px!important;
      padding:14px 12px!important;
    }
    #page2 .exp-side-small{
      align-items:center!important;
    }
    #page2 .finger.thumb-row .bar i{
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a78bfa,#22d3ee)!important;
      box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(167,139,250,.28)!important;
    }

</style>
</head>
<body>
  <main class="app">

    <header class="thesis-header">
      <div class="thesis-logo-box">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo trường">
      </div>

      <div class="thesis-center">
        <div class="school-name">TRƯỜNG ĐẠI HỌC CÔNG NGHỆ KỸ THUẬT TP. HỒ CHÍ MINH</div>
        <div class="faculty-name">KHOA ĐIỆN - ĐIỆN TỬ</div>
        <div class="topic-title">Đề tài: DIGITAL TWIN FOR HAND ROBOT</div>
        <div class="thesis-info">
          <div>GVHD: TS. Trần Vi Đô</div>
          <div class="student-line">SVTH: Phạm Kiến Hào - 22151075</div>
          <div class="student-line">Huỳnh Ngọc Hoàng Anh - 22151047</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="thesis-logo-box">
        <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo khoa">
      </div>
    </header>

    <header class="topbar runtimebar">
      <div class="runtime-left">
        <b>DIGITAL TWIN FOR HAND ROBOT</b>
        <span>Realtime Dashboard · Python · ESP32 · Unity</span>
      </div>

      <div class="top-pills">
        <div class="pill"><span class="live-dot" id="liveDot"></span><span id="liveText">LIVE</span></div>
        <div class="pill">Mode <span id="topMode">AUTO</span></div>
        <div class="pill">Palm Sensor <span id="palmSensorTop" class="palm-mini off">OFF</span></div>
        <div class="pill" id="palmTestPill" onclick="togglePalmTest()" title="Click to toggle PALM TEST. It is locked when the real Palm Sensor is ON.">Palm Test <span id="palmTestTop" class="palm-mini off">OFF</span></div>
        <div class="pill">FPS <span id="topFps" class="cyan-t">0.0</span></div>
        <div class="pill"><span id="latencyBadge">0 ms</span></div>
      </div>
    </header>
    <nav class="tabs"><button class="tabbtn active" id="tabPage1" onclick="selectPage('page1',true)">PAGE 1 · Gesture / Auto-Manu</button><button class="tabbtn" id="tabPage2" onclick="selectPage('page2',true)">PAGE 2 · Experiment Force</button><button class="tabbtn" id="tabPage3" onclick="selectPage('page3',true)">PAGE 3 · Force History</button><span class="nav-status"><span class="status-chip"><b>ESP32</b> <span id="esp32Status">Unknown</span></span><span class="status-chip"><b>Unity</b> <span id="unityStatus">Unknown</span></span></span></nav>

    <section class="page active" id="page1">
      <section class="content-grid">
        <div class="left-stack">
          <article class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div class="head-title"><b>Control Mode</b><span>Direct AUTO/MANU control from web</span></div><div class="badge" id="page1ModeBadge">AUTO</div></div><div class="mode-row"><button class="mode-btn" id="btnAuto" onclick="setMode('AUTO')">AUTO · Gesture detect</button><button class="mode-btn manual" id="btnManu" onclick="setMode('MANU')">MANU · Web sliders</button></div></article>
          <article class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div class="head-title"><b>Auto Command Bars</b><span>5 command bars from gesture/auto pipeline</span></div><div class="badge">AUTO</div></div><div class="control-body" id="autoBars"></div></article>
        </div>
        <div class="right-stack">
          <article class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div class="head-title"><b>Manual Web Sliders</b><span>Sliders are enabled only in MANU mode</span></div><div class="badge amber" id="manualBadge">READY</div></div><div class="control-body" id="manualSliders"></div><div class="manual-disabled-note" id="manualDisabledNote">Currently in AUTO: press MANU before moving sliders.</div></article>
          <article class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div class="head-title"><b>Angle Error Analysis</b><span>Compare hand command and Unity simulated angle</span></div><div class="badge">5 ANGLES</div></div><div class="angle-error-list" id="angleErrorList"></div></article>
        </div>
      </section>
    </section>

    <section class="page" id="page2">
      <section class="exp-wrap">
        <section class="exp-top-grid">
          <div class="exp-card"><div class="exp-ico">◇</div><div><div class="exp-k">Current Object</div><div class="exp-v" id="expObjectName">None</div></div></div>
          <div class="exp-card"><div class="exp-ico">◎</div><div><div class="exp-k">Trial</div><div class="exp-v amber" id="expTrialIndex">0 / 3</div></div></div>
          <div class="exp-card"><div class="exp-ico">↻</div><div><div class="exp-k">Update Cycle</div><div class="exp-v blue" id="expCycleSec">10 s</div></div></div>
          <div class="exp-card"><div class="exp-ico">〽</div><div><div class="exp-k">Status</div><div class="exp-v green" id="expState">WAITING</div></div></div>
          <div class="exp-card"><div class="exp-ico">⌛</div><div><div class="exp-k">Remaining</div><div class="exp-v amber" id="expCountdown">10 s</div></div></div>
        </section>

        <section class="exp-led-row">
          <div class="exp-led" id="expObjectLamp"><i></i><span>Object OK</span></div>
          <div class="exp-led" id="expPalmLamp"><i></i><span>Palm OK</span></div>
          <div class="exp-led" id="expForceLamp"><i></i><span>Force Hold</span></div>
          <div class="exp-led" id="expRecordLamp"><i></i><span>Record Ready</span></div>
        </section>

        <section class="exp-action-row">
          <button class="exp-reset-btn secondary" onclick="resetCurrentExperimentRecord()" title="Xóa 3 lần đo của vật hiện tại, không hủy khóa vật">RESET TRIAL</button>
          <button class="exp-reset-btn" onclick="resetObjectToTracking()" title="Hủy khóa vật, đưa hệ thống về Page 1 / hand tracking">RESET OBJECT · PAGE 1</button>
        </section>

        <section class="exp-main-grid">
          <article class="exp-panel">
            <div class="exp-panel-title">Current Object Results</div>
            <div class="exp-current-body">
              <div class="exp-object-tile"><div class="exp-object-icon" id="expObjectIcon">◇</div><b id="expObjectTitle">None</b></div>
              <div class="exp-trial-grid">
                <div class="exp-trial" id="expTrialCard1"><div class="t">Trial 1</div><div class="n" id="expTrial1">--</div><div class="sub" id="expTrial1Sub">Not recorded</div></div>
                <div class="exp-trial" id="expTrialCard2"><div class="t">Trial 2</div><div class="n" id="expTrial2">--</div><div class="sub" id="expTrial2Sub">Not recorded</div></div>
                <div class="exp-trial" id="expTrialCard3"><div class="t">Trial 3</div><div class="n" id="expTrial3">--</div><div class="sub" id="expTrial3Sub">Not recorded</div></div>
              </div>
              <div class="exp-metric-row">
                <div class="exp-metric"><div class="m-k">Target</div><div class="m-v blue" id="expTarget">--</div></div>
                <div class="exp-metric"><div class="m-k">Average</div><div class="m-v" id="expMean">--</div></div>
                <div class="exp-metric"><div class="m-k">Mean Error</div><div class="m-v" id="expErrN">--</div></div>
                <div class="exp-metric"><div class="m-k">Error %</div><div class="m-v" id="expErrPct">--</div></div>
                <div class="exp-metric"><div class="m-k">Repeat Dev.</div><div class="m-v" id="expRepeat">--</div></div>
                <div class="exp-metric"><div class="m-k">Evaluation</div><div class="m-v ok" id="expEval">--</div></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </article>

          <article class="exp-panel">
            <div class="exp-panel-title">Realtime Grip Force</div>
            <div class="exp-chart-body">
              <div class="exp-chart-box"><canvas id="expForceCanvas" width="760" height="320"></canvas></div>
              <div class="exp-side-readout">
                <div><div class="side-k">10-Second Average</div><div class="side-v"><span id="expWinAvg">0.00</span> N</div></div>
                <div class="exp-side-line"></div>
                <div class="exp-side-small"><span>Target</span><b class="green-t"><span id="expTargetSide">0.00</span> N</b></div>
                <div class="exp-side-small"><span>Error</span><b class="amber-t"><span id="expNowErr">0.00</span> N</b></div>
                <div class="exp-side-small"><span>Error %</span><b class="amber-t"><span id="expNowErrPct">0.00</span>%</b></div>
                <div class="exp-side-line"></div>
                <div class="exp-side-small"><span>Thumb</span><b style="color:#a78bfa"><span id="expThumbNow">0.00</span> N</b></div>
                <div class="exp-side-small"><span>Index</span><b style="color:#60a5fa"><span id="expIndexNow">0.00</span> N</b></div>
                <div class="exp-side-small"><span>Middle</span><b style="color:#22d3ee"><span id="expMiddleNow">0.00</span> N</b></div>
                <div class="exp-side-small"><span>Ring</span><b style="color:#22c55e"><span id="expRingNow">0.00</span> N</b></div>
                <div class="exp-side-small"><span>Pinky</span><b style="color:#fb923c"><span id="expPinkyNow">0.00</span> N</b></div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </article>
        </section>

        <section class="exp-table-panel">
          <div class="exp-table-title">Experiment Summary</div>
          <table class="exp-table">
            <thead><tr><th>No.</th><th>Object</th><th>Target (N)</th><th>Average (N)</th><th>Mean Error (N)</th><th>Error %</th><th>Repeat Dev. (N)</th><th>Evaluation</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody id="expSummaryRows"></tbody>
          </table>
          <div class="exp-footer-note"><span>ⓘ Note: each trial uses the 10-second average to reduce RFP602 sensor noise.</span><span>Updated: <span id="expLastUpdate">--</span></span></div>
        </section>

        <div class="legacy-page2">
          <span id="gripBadge"></span><span id="objectName"></span><span id="objectLabel"></span><span id="massG"></span><span id="loadcellN"></span>
          <span id="requiredMin"></span><span id="requiredMax"></span><span id="targetTotal"></span><span id="actualGripN"></span><span id="gripStateText"></span>
          <span id="forceBadge"></span><canvas id="forceCanvas"></canvas><div id="fingerForces"></div>
          <span id="thumbN"></span><span id="thumbTarget"></span><span id="thumbTouch"></span><span id="thumbRange"></span><span id="thumbForceState"></span><span id="thumbBar"></span>
          <span id="indexN"></span><span id="indexTarget"></span><span id="indexTouch"></span><span id="indexRange"></span><span id="indexForceState"></span><span id="indexBar"></span>
          <span id="middleN"></span><span id="middleTarget"></span><span id="middleTouch"></span><span id="middleRange"></span><span id="middleForceState"></span><span id="middleBar"></span>
          <span id="ringN"></span><span id="ringTarget"></span><span id="ringTouch"></span><span id="ringRange"></span><span id="ringForceState"></span><span id="ringBar"></span>
          <span id="pinkyN"></span><span id="pinkyTarget"></span><span id="pinkyTouch"></span><span id="pinkyRange"></span><span id="pinkyForceState"></span><span id="pinkyBar"></span>
          <div id="servoPulsePanel"></div><span id="pulseGateText"></span><button id="pulseAButton"></button>
          <span id="pulseThumbPct"></span><span id="pulseThumbUs"></span><input id="pulseThumbInput"><button id="pulseThumbBtn"></button>
          <span id="pulseIndexPct"></span><span id="pulseIndexUs"></span><input id="pulseIndexInput"><button id="pulseIndexBtn"></button>
          <span id="pulseMiddlePct"></span><span id="pulseMiddleUs"></span><input id="pulseMiddleInput"><button id="pulseMiddleBtn"></button>
          <span id="pulseRingPct"></span><span id="pulseRingUs"></span><input id="pulseRingInput"><button id="pulseRingBtn"></button>
          <span id="pulsePinkyPct"></span><span id="pulsePinkyUs"></span><input id="pulsePinkyInput"><button id="pulsePinkyBtn"></button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </section>


    <section class="page" id="page3">
      <section class="hist2-wrap">
        <section class="hist2-summary">
          <div class="hist2-card"><div class="hist2-card-k">Total Grips</div><div class="hist2-card-v" id="histTotalRecords">0</div><small>All objects / saved history</small></div>
          <div class="hist2-card"><div class="hist2-card-k">Last Completed Trial</div><div class="hist2-card-v" id="histLastTrial">--</div><small id="histLastRecord">--</small></div>
          <div class="hist2-card"><div class="hist2-card-k">Current Object</div><div class="hist2-card-v amber" id="histActiveObject">None</div><small>Active</small></div>
          <div class="hist2-card"><div class="hist2-card-k">Latest Avg Force</div><div class="hist2-card-v blue"><span id="histLatestAvg">--</span></div><small id="histLatestDate">--</small></div>
        </section>

        <section class="hist2-layout">
          <aside class="hist2-sidebar">
            <div class="hist2-side-title">FILTER & OBJECTS</div>
            <div class="hist2-side-box">
              <div class="hist2-side-k">OBJECT FILTER</div>
              <button class="hist2-filter-btn active" id="histFilter_all" onclick="setHistoryFilter('all')">All Objects <span>✓</span></button>
              <button class="hist2-filter-btn" id="histFilter_orange" onclick="setHistoryFilter('orange')"><i style="background:#f59e0b"></i> Cam (Orange)</button>
              <button class="hist2-filter-btn" id="histFilter_kimquat_sauce" onclick="setHistoryFilter('kimquat_sauce')"><i style="background:#22c55e"></i> Muối ớt kim quất<br><small>(Kimquat Sauce)</small></button>
              <button class="hist2-filter-btn" id="histFilter_red_chili" onclick="setHistoryFilter('red_chili')"><i style="background:#ef4444"></i> Ớt bột<br><small>(Chili Powder)</small></button>
            </div>
            <div class="hist2-side-box">
              <div class="hist2-side-k">ACTIONS</div>
              <button class="hist2-action danger" onclick="deleteSelectedHistoryRows()">DELETE SELECTED</button>
              <button class="hist2-action" onclick="clearHistoryCurrentFilter()">CLEAR CURRENT FILTER</button>
              <button class="hist2-action" onclick="exportHistoryCSV()">EXPORT CSV</button>
              <button class="hist2-action" onclick="printHistoryPDF()">PRINT / PDF</button>
            </div>
            <div class="hist2-side-box">
              <div class="hist2-side-k">QUICK STATS</div>
              <div class="hist2-quick"><span><i style="background:#f59e0b"></i> Cam</span><b id="histCount_orange">0</b></div>
              <div class="hist2-quick"><span><i style="background:#22c55e"></i> Muối ớt kim quất</span><b id="histCount_kimquat_sauce">0</b></div>
              <div class="hist2-quick"><span><i style="background:#ef4444"></i> Ớt bột</span><b id="histCount_red_chili">0</b></div>
              <div class="hist2-quick"><span>Selected rows</span><b id="histSelectedCount">0</b></div>
            </div>
            <div class="hist2-side-note">Page 3 lưu lịch sử vào trình duyệt. Tắt code, mở lại web vẫn còn dữ liệu cho đến khi bạn xóa.</div>
          </aside>

          <section class="hist2-main">
            <div class="hist2-main-head">
              <div><b>🔎 FORCE HISTORY LOG</b><small>Grip-force history of all objects</small></div>
              <div class="hist2-head-actions"><span id="histShowingText">Showing 0 records</span><button onclick="exportHistoryCSV()">EXPORT</button><button onclick="printHistoryPDF()">PDF</button></div>
            </div>
            <div class="hist2-table-wrap">
              <table class="hist2-table">
                <thead><tr>
                  <th>No.</th><th>Object</th><th>Time</th><th>Date</th><th>Trial 1 (N)</th><th>Trial 2 (N)</th><th>Trial 3 (N)</th><th>Avg (N)</th><th>Error %</th><th>Repeat</th><th>Finger Avg (T/I/M/R/P)</th><th>Status</th>
                </tr></thead>
                <tbody id="histAllRows"></tbody>
              </table>
              <div class="hist2-empty" id="histAllEmpty">No force history records yet.</div>
            </div>
            <div class="hist2-table-footer"><span>Click vào dòng hoặc ô No. để chọn, sau đó bấm DELETE SELECTED.</span><span>All forces in Newton (N)</span></div>
          </section>
        </section>
      </section>
    </section>

    <footer class="footer"><span>Page 1: AUTO/MANU · Page 2: current force test · Page 3: force history · Camera stays in Python window.</span><span>DATN Robot Hand · V40 pulse panel</span></footer>
  </main>

<script>
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id); const history=[]; const fingers=[['thumb','Thumb'],['index','Index'],['middle','Middle'],['ring','Ring'],['pinky','Pinky']];
let currentPage='page1';
let manualLockUntil=0;
let lastData={};
let controlMode='AUTO';
let manual={thumb:0,index:0,middle:0,ring:0,pinky:0};
let servoPulsePanelOn=false;
const pulseFingers=[['thumb','Thumb'],['index','Index'],['middle','Middle'],['ring','Ring'],['pinky','Pinky']];
const servoOpenUs={thumb:800,index:650,middle:800,ring:2200,pinky:2300};
const servoCloseUs={thumb:1500,index:2000,middle:2000,ring:800,pinky:1000};
function servoUsFromPct(k,pct){
  const open=Number(servoOpenUs[k]??0), close=Number(servoCloseUs[k]??0);
  const p=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(pct)||0));
  if(!Number.isFinite(open)||!Number.isFinite(close)||open<=0||close<=0) return 0;
  return Math.round(open+(close-open)*p/100.0);
}
function isTypingTarget(el){
  if(!el) return false;
  const tag=String(el.tagName||'').toLowerCase();
  return tag==='input'||tag==='textarea'||tag==='select'||el.isContentEditable;
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(ev){
  if(ev.ctrlKey||ev.altKey||ev.metaKey) return;
  if(String(ev.key||'').toLowerCase()==='a'){
    if(isTypingTarget(document.activeElement)) return;
    ev.preventDefault();
    togglePulsePanel();
  }
});

// V13 OBJECT PAGE LATCH:
// Khi YOLO nhan vat 1 lan, web chuyen sang Page 2 va giu Page 2.
// Neu dua vat ra khoi khung hinh, web KHONG tu nhay ve Page 1 nua.
// Page 1 chi quay lai khi nguoi dung bam tab Page 1.
let objectLatch={
  active:false,
  label:'none',
  name:'None',
  mass_g:0,
  required_min_n:0,
  required_max_n:0,
  target_total_n:0,
  lockedAt:0
};
function fmt(x,d=2){const n=Number(x);return Number.isFinite(n)?n.toFixed(d):(0).toFixed(d)} function pct(x,max=18.5){const n=Number(x);return Number.isFinite(n)?Math.max(0,Math.min(100,n/max*100)):0} function upper(s){return String(s||'').toUpperCase()} function cleanState(s){return String(s||'').replace('_AUTO','').replaceAll('_',' ')}
const FORCE_CONTACT_N=0.25, FORCE_LOW_MARGIN_N=0.30, FORCE_HIGH_MARGIN_N=1.20;
function forceBand(actual,touch){actual=Number(actual)||0;touch=Number(touch)||0;if(touch<=0||actual<FORCE_CONTACT_N){return{active:false,touch:0,low:0,high:0,state:'NO TOUCH',cls:'amber-t'}}const low=Math.max(0,touch-FORCE_LOW_MARGIN_N),high=touch+FORCE_HIGH_MARGIN_N;let state='HOLD',cls='green-t';if(actual<low){state='CLOSING';cls='amber-t'}else if(actual>high){state='OVER';cls='orange-t'}return{active:true,touch,low,high,state,cls}}
function totalGripState(actual,target,reqMin,reqMax,activeCount){actual=Number(actual)||0;target=Number(target)||0;reqMin=Number(reqMin)||0;reqMax=Number(reqMax)||0;activeCount=Number(activeCount)||0;if(target<=0)return{txt:'NO OBJECT',cls:'amber-t'};if(activeCount<=0||actual<FORCE_CONTACT_N)return{txt:'WAIT TOUCH',cls:'amber-t'};if(reqMin>0&&actual<reqMin)return{txt:'LOW FORCE',cls:'amber-t'};if(reqMax>0&&actual>reqMax)return{txt:'HIGH FORCE',cls:'orange-t'};return{txt:'HOLD OK',cls:'green-t'}}
function setTextClass(el,cls){if(!el)return;el.classList.remove('green-t','cyan-t','amber-t','red-t','orange-t');if(cls)el.classList.add(cls)} function setBadgeClass(el,cls){if(!el)return;el.classList.remove('green','amber','red');if(cls)el.classList.add(cls)}
function hasDetectedObject(d){
  return Boolean(d.object_label && d.object_label !== 'none' && d.object_name && d.object_name !== 'None');
}

function updateObjectLatch(d){
  if(!hasDetectedObject(d)) return;

  objectLatch.active=true;
  objectLatch.label=d.object_label || 'none';
  objectLatch.name=d.object_name || 'None';
  objectLatch.mass_g=Number(d.mass_g || 0);
  objectLatch.required_min_n=Number(d.required_min_n || 0);
  objectLatch.required_max_n=Number(d.required_max_n || 0);
  objectLatch.target_total_n=Number(d.target_total_n || 0);
  objectLatch.lockedAt=Date.now();
}

function getDisplayObjectData(d){
  // Neu vat da tung duoc nhan dien, giu ten/khoi luong/target tren Page 2
  // ngay ca khi vat da roi khoi khung hinh camera.
  if(!hasDetectedObject(d) && objectLatch.active){
    return {
      label:objectLatch.label,
      name:objectLatch.name,
      mass_g:objectLatch.mass_g,
      required_min_n:Number(d.required_min_n || objectLatch.required_min_n || 0),
      required_max_n:Number(d.required_max_n || objectLatch.required_max_n || 0),
      target_total_n:Number(d.target_total_n || objectLatch.target_total_n || 0),
    };
  }

  return {
    label:d.object_label || 'none',
    name:d.object_name || 'None',
    mass_g:Number(d.mass_g || 0),
    required_min_n:Number(d.required_min_n || 0),
    required_max_n:Number(d.required_max_n || 0),
    target_total_n:Number(d.target_total_n || 0),
  };
}

function selectPage(p,user=false){
  currentPage=p;
  if(user) manualLockUntil=Date.now()+8000;
  ['page1','page2','page3'].forEach(id=>{const el=$(id); if(el)el.classList.toggle('active',id===p);});
  if($('tabPage1'))$('tabPage1').classList.toggle('active',p==='page1');
  if($('tabPage2'))$('tabPage2').classList.toggle('active',p==='page2');
  if($('tabPage3'))$('tabPage3').classList.toggle('active',p==='page3');
  document.body.classList.toggle('exp-mode',p==='page2'||p==='page3');
  if(p==='page3')renderHistoryPage();
}

function autoSwitchPage(d){
  const hasObj=hasDetectedObject(d);
  updateObjectLatch(d);

  if(Date.now()<manualLockUntil) return;

  // V13: Co vat -> tu dong qua Page 2.
  // Mat vat -> KHONG tu dong ve Page 1 nua.
  // Ly do: thuc te dua vat qua camera 1 lan de he thong biet vat,
  // sau do vat co the nam sau lung camera / ngoai khung hinh.
  if(hasObj && currentPage!=='page2') selectPage('page2',false);
}
async function postControl(payload){try{await fetch('/api/control',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(payload)})}catch(e){}}

function clearObjectLatchUi(){
  objectLatch={active:false,label:'none',name:'None',mass_g:0,required_min_n:0,required_max_n:0,target_total_n:0,lockedAt:0};
  try{
    expState.activeLabel='none';
    expState.windowStart=0;
    expState.samples=[];
    expState.chartSamples=[];
  }catch(e){}
}

function resetObjectToTracking(){
  clearObjectLatchUi();
  manualLockUntil=Date.now()+8000;
  postControl({mode:'AUTO',reset_to_tracking:true});
  selectPage('page1',true);
}

function resetCurrentExperimentRecord(){
  const label=(expState&&expState.activeLabel&&expState.activeLabel!=='none')?expState.activeLabel:(objectLatch&&objectLatch.label?objectLatch.label:'none');
  if(label && label!=='none' && expState.records && expState.records[label]){
    expState.records[label].trials=[null,null,null];
    expState.records[label].trialDetails=[null,null,null];
    expState.records[label].nextIndex=0;
    expState.records[label].historyLogged=false;
    expState.records[label].waitingRelease=false;
    expState.records[label].updated=Date.now();
    expSave();
  }
  expState.windowStart=Date.now();
  expState.samples=[];
  expUpdateRows();
}

function togglePalmTest(){
  if(lastData && lastData.palm_sensor){return;}
  postControl({palm_test_toggle:true});
}
function pulseGateOpen(d){
  if(!d)return false;
  const hasObj=Boolean((d.object_label&&d.object_label!=='none')||objectLatch.active);
  const active=Number(d.touch_target_active_count||0);
  const total=Number(d.fsr_index_n||0)+Number(d.fsr_middle_n||0)+Number(d.fsr_ring_n||0)+Number(d.fsr_pinky_n||0);
  return Boolean(hasObj && (active>=1 || total>=0.25));
}
function togglePulsePanel(){
  // V36: A only shows/hides the compact panel.
  // Inputs are locked by gate condition, but the panel can always be displayed for checking current pulse.
  servoPulsePanelOn=!servoPulsePanelOn;
  if(!servoPulsePanelOn){postControl({servo_pulse_override_enabled:false});}
  updatePulsePanel(lastData||{});
}
function sendPulseUs(k){
  const inp=$('pulse'+k.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+k.slice(1)+'Input');
  if(!inp || !servoPulsePanelOn || !pulseGateOpen(lastData)){return;}
  let us=parseInt(inp.value,10);
  if(!Number.isFinite(us))return;
  us=Math.max(400,Math.min(2500,us));
  inp.value=String(us);
  const p={servo_pulse_override_enabled:true};
  p['servo_pulse_'+k+'_us']=us;
  postControl(p);
}
function updatePulsePanel(d){
  const gate=pulseGateOpen(d);
  const panel=$('servoPulsePanel'), btn=$('pulseAButton'), gt=$('pulseGateText');
  if(panel){panel.classList.toggle('show',servoPulsePanelOn);panel.classList.toggle('locked',servoPulsePanelOn&&!gate);}
  if(btn){btn.classList.toggle('on',servoPulsePanelOn);btn.disabled=false;}
  if(gt){gt.textContent=servoPulsePanelOn?(gate?'READY':'INPUT LOCKED'):'OFF';gt.className='pulse-gate '+(servoPulsePanelOn?(gate?'open':''):'off')}
  pulseFingers.forEach(([k,name])=>{
    const cap=k.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+k.slice(1);
    const pctRaw=Number(d['servo_'+k+'_pct']||d['unity_'+k+'_pct']||0);
    const pct=Number.isFinite(pctRaw)?pctRaw:0;
    // Display pulse follows the percent shown beside it:
    // 0% = openUs, 100% = closeUs. Ring/Pinky can decrease when closing.
    let us=servoUsFromPct(k,pct);
    // If percentage is unavailable but ESP32 sent a valid readback, use readback as fallback.
    const serverUs=Number(d['servo_'+k+'_us']||0);
    if((!us || us<=0) && Number.isFinite(serverUs) && serverUs>=400 && serverUs<=2500) us=serverUs;
    if($('pulse'+cap+'Pct'))$('pulse'+cap+'Pct').textContent=Math.round(pct)+'%';
    if($('pulse'+cap+'Us'))$('pulse'+cap+'Us').textContent=us?String(Math.round(us)):'0';
    const inp=$('pulse'+cap+'Input'), ok=$('pulse'+cap+'Btn');
    if(inp){inp.disabled=!(servoPulsePanelOn&&gate);inp.title=gate?'Enter 400-2500 us':'Locked: need object + at least one FSR touch';}
    if(ok){ok.disabled=!(servoPulsePanelOn&&gate);ok.title=gate?'Send raw servo pulse':'Locked: need object + at least one FSR touch';}
  });
}
function setMode(m){controlMode=m;postControl({mode:m,...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(manual).map(([k,v])=>['manual_'+k+'_pct',v]))});renderMode()}
function renderMode(){const isManu=controlMode==='MANU';if($('btnAuto'))$('btnAuto').classList.toggle('active',controlMode==='AUTO'); if($('btnManu'))$('btnManu').classList.toggle('active',isManu); if($('page1ModeBadge'))$('page1ModeBadge').textContent=controlMode; if($('manualBadge'))$('manualBadge').textContent=isManu?'WEB MANU ACTIVE':'READY'; if($('manualDisabledNote'))$('manualDisabledNote').classList.toggle('show',!isManu); fingers.forEach(([k])=>{const el=$('man_'+k); if(el)el.disabled=!isManu})}
function handleManualInput(k,el){if(controlMode!=='MANU'){el.value=String(Math.round(manual[k]||0));return;}manual[k]=Number(el.value);$('man_'+k+'_val').textContent=el.value+'%';const p={mode:'MANU'};p['manual_'+k+'_pct']=manual[k];postControl(p)}
function buildControls(){const auto=$('autoBars'), man=$('manualSliders'), force=$('fingerForces'), err=$('angleErrorList'); if(auto)auto.innerHTML=''; if(man)man.innerHTML=''; if(force)force.innerHTML=''; if(err)err.innerHTML='';
  if(auto)fingers.forEach(([k,name])=>{auto.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="control-row"><div class="control-top"><b>${name}</b><span><span id="auto_${k}">0</span>%</span></div><div class="bar"><i id="auto_${k}_bar"></i></div></div>`)});
  if(man)fingers.forEach(([k,name])=>{man.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="sliderline"><b>${name}</b><input id="man_${k}" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="0" oninput="handleManualInput('${k}',this)"><span id="man_${k}_val">0%</span></div>`)});
  if(force)fingers.forEach(([k,name])=>{force.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="finger ${k==='thumb'?'thumb-row':''}"><div class="finger-top"><b>${name}</b><span class="force-metrics" title="A=Actual FSR force, Tg=initial equal target, Tc=touch target, OK=allowed force band"><span>A <span id="${k}N">0.00</span>N</span><span>Tg <span class="target-t" id="${k}Target">0.00</span>N</span><span>Tc <span class="amber-t" id="${k}Touch">0.00</span>N</span><span>OK <span class="cyan-t" id="${k}Range">0.00-0.00</span>N</span><span class="force-state" id="${k}ForceState">NO TOUCH</span></span></div><div class="bar"><i id="${k}Bar" ${k==='pinky'?'class="warn"':''}></i></div></div>`)});
  fingers.forEach(([k,name])=>{if(err)err.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="angle-row"><b>${name}</b><span class="angle-mid">Hand <span id="hand_${k}">0</span>% · Unity <span id="unity_${k}">0</span>%</span><span class="angle-err" id="err_${k}">0°</span></div>`)})
}
function bar(id,val,max=100,warn=false){const el=$(id);if(!el)return;el.style.width=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(val||0)/max*100))+'%'; if(warn)el.classList.add('warn'); else el.classList.remove('warn')}
function statusText(id,value){const el=$(id);if(!el)return;el.textContent=value;const s=upper(value);if(s.includes('CONNECTED')||s.includes('OK')||s.includes('ACTIVE')||s.includes('READY')||s.includes('RUN')||s.includes('ON'))setTextClass(el,'green-t');else if(s.includes('OFF')||s.includes('UNKNOWN')||s.includes('WAIT')||s.includes('DISABLED'))setTextClass(el,'amber-t');else if(s.includes('ERROR')||s.includes('FAIL'))setTextClass(el,'red-t');else setTextClass(el,'')}
function getChartSurface(c){
  const dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const rect=c.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cssW=Math.max(1,Math.round(rect.width||c.clientWidth||760));
  const cssH=Math.max(1,Math.round(rect.height||c.clientHeight||300));
  const pxW=Math.round(cssW*dpr),pxH=Math.round(cssH*dpr);
  if(c.width!==pxW||c.height!==pxH){c.width=pxW;c.height=pxH}
  const ctx=c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
  return {ctx,w:cssW,h:cssH};
}
function drawChart(thumb,index,middle,ring,pinky){
  history.push({thumb:Number(thumb)||0,index:Number(index)||0,middle:Number(middle)||0,ring:Number(ring)||0,pinky:Number(pinky)||0});
  if(history.length>105)history.shift();
  const c=$('forceCanvas'); if(!c)return; const surface=getChartSurface(c),ctx=surface.ctx,w=surface.w,h=surface.h;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  const padL=44,padR=16,padT=16,padB=34,pw=w-padL-padR,ph=h-padT-padB;
  const maxVal=Math.max(4,...history.flatMap(p=>[p.thumb,p.index,p.middle,p.ring,p.pinky]))*1.25;
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(148,163,184,.20)';
  ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(190,205,225,.90)';
  ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui';
  for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){
    const y=padT+ph/4*i;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(padL,y);
    ctx.lineTo(w-padR,y);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillText((maxVal-maxVal/4*i).toFixed(1),7,y+5);
  }
  function point(i,v){return[padL+(history.length<=1?0:i*(pw/(history.length-1))),padT+ph-(v/maxVal)*ph]}
  function line(key,color,width){
    ctx.strokeStyle=color;
    ctx.lineWidth=width;
    ctx.lineJoin='round';
    ctx.lineCap='round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    history.forEach((p,i)=>{const [x,y]=point(i,p[key]);if(i===0)ctx.moveTo(x,y);else ctx.lineTo(x,y)});
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  line('thumb','rgba(167,139,250,.96)',3.0);
  line('index','rgba(96,165,250,.96)',3.0);
  line('middle','rgba(34,211,238,.98)',3.0);
  line('ring','rgba(34,197,94,.96)',3.0);
  line('pinky','rgba(251,146,60,.96)',3.0);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(226,232,240,.94)';
  ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('Realtime finger force trend (N)',padL,h-12);
}

// ===================== PAGE 2 EXPERIMENT MEASUREMENT =====================
const EXP_CYCLE_MS=10000;
const EXP_IMG_KIMQUAT='data:image/png;base64,';
const EXP_IMG_CHILI='data:image/png;base64,';
const EXP_OBJECTS=[
  ['orange','Cam','🍊','#f59e0b','emoji'],
  ['kimquat_sauce','Muối ớt kim quất',EXP_IMG_KIMQUAT,'#22c55e','img'],
  ['red_chili','Ớt bột',EXP_IMG_CHILI,'#ef4444','img']
];
let expState={activeLabel:'none',windowStart:0,samples:[],chartSamples:[],records:{},releaseSince:0};
const HISTORY_STORAGE_KEY='datn_force_history_records_v60_persistent';
let historyState=loadHistoryState();
let histFilter='all';
let histSelected={};
// RAM-only experiment records.
// Do not persist trial results in browser localStorage.
// This prevents old measurements from reappearing after stopping Python and running it again.
const EXP_STORAGE_KEY='datn_exp_records_ram_only_no_persist';
try{
  // Clear all older persistent keys once; current version keeps records only in RAM.
  localStorage.removeItem('datn_exp_records_v2');
  localStorage.removeItem('datn_exp_records_v3');
  localStorage.removeItem('datn_exp_records_v4_7s_isolated');
  localStorage.removeItem(EXP_STORAGE_KEY);
}catch(e){}
function expSave(){
  // Intentionally empty: records live only in JavaScript RAM for the current page session.
}
function expValidTrial(v){
  // Number(null) and Number('') are 0 in JavaScript.  They are empty slots,
  // not completed measurements.  A recorded trial must also pass the same
  // minimum-force gate used by recordReady.
  if(v===null || v===undefined || v==='')return false;
  const n=Number(v);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n>0.05;
}
function expMeta(label){
  const found=EXP_OBJECTS.find(x=>x[0]===label);
  return found?{label:found[0],name:found[1],icon:found[2],color:found[3],type:found[4]||'emoji'}:{label:'none',name:'None',icon:'◇',color:'#94a3b8',type:'emoji'};
}
function expVisualHtml(meta,small=false){
  if(meta && meta.type==='img' && String(meta.icon||'').startsWith('data:image')){
    return `<img class="${small?'exp-table-img':'exp-object-img'}" src="${meta.icon}" alt="${meta.name||''}">`;
  }
  return `<span class="${small?'exp-table-emoji':'exp-object-emoji'}" style="color:${meta?.color||'#94a3b8'}">${meta?.icon||'◇'}</span>`;
}
function expSetVisual(id,meta){
  const el=$(id); if(!el)return;
  el.innerHTML=expVisualHtml(meta,false);
}
function expEnsure(label,target){
  if(!label||label==='none')return null;
  let changed=false;
  if(!expState.records[label]){
    expState.records[label]={target:0,trials:[null,null,null],trialDetails:[null,null,null],updated:0,nextIndex:0,cycleNo:0,historyLogged:false,waitingRelease:false};
    changed=true;
  }
  const rec=expState.records[label];
  if(!Array.isArray(rec.trials)){
    rec.trials=[null,null,null];
    changed=true;
  }
  if(!Array.isArray(rec.trialDetails)){rec.trialDetails=[null,null,null];changed=true;}
  if(!Number.isFinite(Number(rec.nextIndex))){rec.nextIndex=0;changed=true;}
  if(!Number.isFinite(Number(rec.cycleNo))){rec.cycleNo=0;changed=true;}
  if(typeof rec.historyLogged!=='boolean'){rec.historyLogged=false;changed=true;}
  if(typeof rec.waitingRelease!=='boolean'){rec.waitingRelease=false;changed=true;}
  const normalized=[0,1,2].map(i=>expValidTrial(rec.trials[i])?Number(rec.trials[i]):null);
  if(JSON.stringify(normalized)!==JSON.stringify(rec.trials)){
    rec.trials=normalized;
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){if(!expValidTrial(rec.trials[i]))rec.trialDetails[i]=null;}
    changed=true;
  }
  if(Number(target)>0 && Math.abs(Number(rec.target||0)-Number(target))>0.001){
    rec.target=Number(target);
    changed=true;
  }
  if(changed)expSave();
  return rec;
}
function expStats(rec){
  const vals=(rec?.trials||[]).filter(expValidTrial).map(Number);
  const target=Number(rec?.target||0);
  if(!vals.length)return{mean:null,err:null,errPct:null,rep:null,eval:'--',count:0};
  const mean=vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length;
  const err=target>0?Math.abs(mean-target):null;
  const errPct=(target>0&&err!==null)?err/target*100:null;
  const rep=vals.length>=2?(Math.max(...vals)-Math.min(...vals)):0;
  let evalTxt='WAIT';
  if(vals.length>=3){
    if(errPct!==null && errPct<=10)evalTxt='OK';
    else if(errPct!==null && errPct<=20)evalTxt='CHECK';
    else evalTxt='NG';
  }
  return{mean,err,errPct,rep,eval:evalTxt,count:vals.length};
}
function expCurrentLabel(d,od){
  if(d.object_label&&d.object_label!=='none')return d.object_label;
  if(objectLatch.active&&objectLatch.label&&objectLatch.label!=='none')return objectLatch.label;
  if(od&&od.label&&od.label!=='none')return od.label;
  return 'none';
}
function expSet(id,text,cls){
  const el=$(id); if(!el)return;
  el.textContent=text;
  if(cls!==undefined){el.className=el.className.replace(/\b(green-t|amber-t|cyan-t|orange-t|red-t)\b/g,'').trim(); if(cls)el.classList.add(cls);}
}
function expLamp(id,on,warn=false){
  const el=$(id); if(!el)return;
  el.classList.toggle('ok',!!on&&!warn);
  el.classList.toggle('warn',!!on&&!!warn);
}
function expFmtN(v){return expValidTrial(v)?fmt(v,2)+' N':'--'}
function expUpdateRows(){
  const body=$('expSummaryRows'); if(!body)return;
  body.innerHTML='';
  EXP_OBJECTS.forEach((o,i)=>{
    const [label,name,icon,color]=o;
    const rec=expState.records[label]||{target:0,trials:[null,null,null]};
    const st=expStats(rec);
    const evalHtml=st.eval==='OK'?'<span class="ok-pill">OK</span>':(st.eval==='NG'?'<span class="red-t">NG</span>':(st.eval==='CHECK'?'<span class="amber-t">CHECK</span>':'<span class="amber-t">Chờ đo</span>'));
    body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<tr>
      <td>${i+1}</td>
      <td><span class="exp-table-object">${expVisualHtml({icon,type:o[4]||'emoji',color,name},true)}<span>${name}</span></span></td>
      <td>${rec.target?fmt(rec.target,2):'--'}</td>
      <td>${st.mean!==null?fmt(st.mean,2):'--'}</td>
      <td>${st.err!==null?fmt(st.err,2):'--'}</td>
      <td>${st.errPct!==null?fmt(st.errPct,2)+'%':'--'}</td>
      <td>${st.rep!==null?fmt(st.rep,2):'--'}</td>
      <td>${evalHtml}</td>
    </tr>`);
  });
}
function drawExpChart(target){
  const c=$('expForceCanvas'); if(!c)return;
  const surface=getChartSurface(c),ctx=surface.ctx,w=surface.w,h=surface.h;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  const padL=48,padR=18,padT=22,padB=34,pw=w-padL-padR,ph=h-padT-padB;

  // V54: draw 4 real RFP602 finger-force lines instead of only total force.
  // Total force is still shown as the dashed target/average readout on the right.
  const samples=expState.chartSamples.slice(-120);
  const keys=[
    ['thumb','Thumb','#a78bfa'],
    ['index','Index','#60a5fa'],
    ['middle','Middle','#22d3ee'],
    ['ring','Ring','#22c55e'],
    ['pinky','Pinky','#fb923c'],
  ];
  const values=[];
  samples.forEach(s=>{keys.forEach(([k])=>values.push(Number(s[k]||0)));});
  const perFingerTarget=Number(target||0)>0 ? Number(target||0)/5.0 : 0;
  const maxVal=Math.max(1.0,perFingerTarget*1.8,...values)*1.10;

  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(148,163,184,.18)';ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(226,232,240,.86)';ctx.font='11px system-ui';
  for(let i=0;i<=5;i++){
    const y=padT+ph/5*i;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(padL,y);ctx.lineTo(w-padR,y);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillText((maxVal-maxVal/5*i).toFixed(2),8,y+4);
  }
  const windowSec=EXP_CYCLE_MS/1000;
  for(let i=0;i<=5;i++){
    const x=padL+pw/5*i;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,padT);ctx.lineTo(x,padT+ph);ctx.stroke();
    const sec=-windowSec + (windowSec/5)*i;
    const label=(Math.abs(sec)<0.01?'0':(Number.isInteger(sec)?String(sec):sec.toFixed(1)))+' s';
    ctx.fillText(label,x-12,h-10);
  }
  function xAt(ts){const now=Date.now();return padL+pw-Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(now-ts)/EXP_CYCLE_MS))*pw}
  function yAt(v){return padT+ph-(Number(v||0)/maxVal)*ph}

  if(perFingerTarget>0){
    const y=yAt(perFingerTarget);
    ctx.setLineDash([6,5]);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(74,222,128,.65)';ctx.lineWidth=1.7;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(padL,y);ctx.lineTo(w-padR,y);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
  }

  keys.forEach(([k,label,color])=>{
    const has=samples.some(s=>Number(s[k]||0)>0);
    if(!samples.length || !has)return;
    ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=2.6;ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.beginPath();
    let started=false;
    samples.forEach(s=>{
      const x=xAt(s.t),y=yAt(s[k]);
      if(!started){ctx.moveTo(x,y);started=true;}else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
    });
    ctx.stroke();
  });

  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(226,232,240,.92)';ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('Finger force trend (N) - 10-second window',padL,padT-6);
  let lx=padL,ly=h-12;
  keys.forEach(([k,label,color])=>{
    ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fillRect(lx,ly-7,18,3);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(226,232,240,.86)';ctx.font='11px system-ui';ctx.fillText(label,lx+24,ly);
    lx+=82;
  });
  if(perFingerTarget>0){
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(74,222,128,.65)';ctx.setLineDash([5,4]);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(lx,ly-6);ctx.lineTo(lx+18,ly-6);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle='rgba(226,232,240,.80)';ctx.fillText('Target/finger',lx+24,ly);
  }
}
function expMeanOf(arr,key){
  const vals=(arr||[]).map(x=>Number(x&&x[key]||0)).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v));
  return vals.length?vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length:0;
}
function expBuildTrialDetail(samples){
  return {
    total: expMeanOf(samples,'v'),
    thumb: expMeanOf(samples,'thumb'),
    index: expMeanOf(samples,'index'),
    middle: expMeanOf(samples,'middle'),
    ring: expMeanOf(samples,'ring'),
    pinky: expMeanOf(samples,'pinky'),
    t: Date.now()
  };
}
function expAvgDetail(details,key){
  const vals=(details||[]).filter(Boolean).map(x=>Number(x[key]||0)).filter(v=>Number.isFinite(v));
  return vals.length?vals.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/vals.length:0;
}
function historyBaseState(){return{byLabel:{orange:[],kimquat_sauce:[],red_chili:[]},lastRecordTs:0,nextNo:1};}
function historyNormalizeNumbers(state,doSave=false){
  const hs=state||historyState;
  if(!hs || !hs.byLabel)return;
  const all=[];
  ['orange','kimquat_sauce','red_chili'].forEach(label=>{
    if(!Array.isArray(hs.byLabel[label]))hs.byLabel[label]=[];
    hs.byLabel[label].forEach(r=>{
      if(!r.id)r.id='h_'+String(r.ts||Date.now())+'_'+Math.random().toString(16).slice(2);
      r.label=label;
      all.push(r);
    });
  });
  all.sort((a,b)=>Number(a.ts||0)-Number(b.ts||0)); // oldest = No.1
  all.forEach((r,i)=>{r.no=i+1;});
  hs.nextNo=all.length+1;
  hs.lastRecordTs=all.length?Number(all[all.length-1].ts||0):0;
  if(doSave && hs===historyState)historySave();
}
function loadHistoryState(){
  const base=historyBaseState();
  try{
    const raw=localStorage.getItem(HISTORY_STORAGE_KEY);
    if(!raw)return base;
    const data=JSON.parse(raw);
    if(data&&data.byLabel){
      ['orange','kimquat_sauce','red_chili'].forEach(label=>{
        base.byLabel[label]=Array.isArray(data.byLabel[label])?data.byLabel[label]:[];
        base.byLabel[label].forEach(r=>{if(!r.id)r.id='h_'+String(r.ts||Date.now())+'_'+Math.random().toString(16).slice(2); if(!r.label)r.label=label;});
      });
      base.lastRecordTs=Number(data.lastRecordTs||0);
      base.nextNo=Number(data.nextNo||0)||1;
      const maxNo=Math.max(0,...Object.values(base.byLabel).flat().map(r=>Number(r.no||0)));
      if(base.nextNo<=maxNo)base.nextNo=maxNo+1;
    }
  }catch(e){}
  historyNormalizeNumbers(base,false);
  return base;
}
function historySave(){try{localStorage.setItem(HISTORY_STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify(historyState));}catch(e){}}
function histAllRows(){return ['orange','kimquat_sauce','red_chili'].flatMap(label=>(historyState.byLabel[label]||[]).map(r=>Object.assign({label},r))).sort((a,b)=>Number(b.ts||0)-Number(a.ts||0));}
function historyAppendFromRecord(label,rec){
  if(!label || label==='none' || !rec || rec.historyLogged)return;
  const details=(rec.trialDetails||[]).filter(Boolean);
  const vals=(rec.trials||[]).filter(expValidTrial).map(Number);
  if(vals.length<3 || details.length<3)return;
  const st=expStats(rec);
  const row={
    id:'h_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(16).slice(2),
    no:historyState.nextNo++,
    label:label,
    ts:Date.now(),
    target:Number(rec.target||0),
    trials:vals.slice(0,3),
    details:details.slice(0,3),
    mean:st.mean,
    err:st.err,
    errPct:st.errPct,
    rep:st.rep,
    eval:st.eval,
    fingerAvg:{thumb:expAvgDetail(details,'thumb'),index:expAvgDetail(details,'index'),middle:expAvgDetail(details,'middle'),ring:expAvgDetail(details,'ring'),pinky:expAvgDetail(details,'pinky')}
  };
  if(!historyState.byLabel[label])historyState.byLabel[label]=[];
  historyState.byLabel[label].unshift(row);
  // Keep enough local history for demo/report without making the browser too heavy.
  historyState.byLabel[label]=historyState.byLabel[label].slice(0,500);
  historyNormalizeNumbers(historyState,false);
  rec.historyLogged=true;
  rec.waitingRelease=true;
  historySave();
  expSave();
  renderHistoryPage();
}
function setHistoryFilter(label){histFilter=label||'all';histSelected={};renderHistoryPage();}
function historyRowsForCurrentFilter(){const rows=histAllRows();return histFilter==='all'?rows:rows.filter(r=>r.label===histFilter);}
function toggleHistoryRow(id,ev){if(ev&&ev.target&&ev.target.classList&&ev.target.classList.contains('hist2-check')){} if(!id)return;histSelected[id]=!histSelected[id];renderHistoryPage();}
function deleteSelectedHistoryRows(){
  const ids=Object.keys(histSelected).filter(k=>histSelected[k]);
  if(!ids.length){alert('Chưa chọn dòng lịch sử nào. Click vào dòng hoặc ô No. trước.');return;}
  if(!confirm('Xóa '+ids.length+' dòng lịch sử đã chọn?'))return;
  const idSet=new Set(ids);
  ['orange','kimquat_sauce','red_chili'].forEach(label=>{historyState.byLabel[label]=(historyState.byLabel[label]||[]).filter(r=>!idSet.has(r.id));});
  histSelected={};
  historyNormalizeNumbers(historyState,false);
  historySave();renderHistoryPage();
}
function clearHistoryCurrentFilter(){
  if(histFilter==='all'){
    if(!confirm('Xóa toàn bộ lịch sử của tất cả vật?'))return;
    historyState=historyBaseState();
  }else{
    const meta=expMeta(histFilter);
    if(!confirm('Xóa toàn bộ lịch sử của '+meta.name+'?'))return;
    historyState.byLabel[histFilter]=[];
    historyNormalizeNumbers(historyState,false);
  }
  histSelected={};historySave();renderHistoryPage();
}
function clearHistoryObject(label){histFilter=label||histFilter;clearHistoryCurrentFilter();}
function histFmtTime(ts){try{return new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB')}catch(e){return '--'}}
function histFmtDate(ts){try{return new Date(ts).toLocaleDateString('en-GB')}catch(e){return '--'}}
function histStatusClass(r){const p=Number(r.errPct);if(Number.isFinite(p)){if(p<=5)return ''; if(p<=10)return 'warn'; return 'err';}return 'warn';}
function histObjectClass(label){return label==='kimquat_sauce'?'kimquat_sauce':(label==='red_chili'?'red_chili':'orange');}
function renderHistoryPage(){
  historyNormalizeNumbers(historyState,false);
  ['all','orange','kimquat_sauce','red_chili'].forEach(l=>{const b=$('histFilter_'+l);if(b)b.classList.toggle('active',histFilter===l);});
  const rows=historyRowsForCurrentFilter();
  const body=$('histAllRows'), empty=$('histAllEmpty');
  if(body){
    body.innerHTML='';
    rows.forEach((r)=>{
      const meta=expMeta(r.label);
      const f=r.fingerAvg||{};
      const t=(r.trials||[]).map(v=>fmt(v,3)).concat(['--','--','--']).slice(0,3);
      const sel=!!histSelected[r.id];
      const objCls=histObjectClass(r.label);
      body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<tr class="${sel?'selected':''}" onclick="toggleHistoryRow('${r.id}',event)">
        <td><span class="hist2-no"><input class="hist2-check" type="checkbox" ${sel?'checked':''} onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleHistoryRow('${r.id}',event)"><b>${r.no}</b></span></td>
        <td><span class="hist2-object-tag ${objCls}">${meta.name}</span></td>
        <td>${histFmtTime(r.ts)}</td><td>${histFmtDate(r.ts)}</td>
        <td>${t[0]}</td><td>${t[1]}</td><td>${t[2]}</td>
        <td><b>${r.mean!==null?fmt(r.mean,3):'--'}</b></td>
        <td class="${Number(r.errPct||0)>10?'red-t':'green-t'}">${r.errPct!==null?fmt(r.errPct,2):'--'}</td>
        <td>${r.rep!==null?fmt(r.rep,3):'--'}</td>
        <td>${fmt(f.thumb||0,2)} / ${fmt(f.index||0,2)} / ${fmt(f.middle||0,2)} / ${fmt(f.ring||0,2)} / ${fmt(f.pinky||0,2)}</td>
        <td><span class="hist2-status-dot ${histStatusClass(r)}"></span></td>
      </tr>`);
    });
  }
  if(empty)empty.style.display=rows.length?'none':'block';
  const all=histAllRows();
  const total=all.length;
  expSet('histTotalRecords',String(total));
  expSet('histShowingText',`Showing ${rows.length} of ${total} records`);
  expSet('histSelectedCount',String(Object.values(histSelected).filter(Boolean).length));
  ['orange','kimquat_sauce','red_chili'].forEach(label=>expSet('histCount_'+label,String((historyState.byLabel[label]||[]).length)));
  const active=expMeta(expState.activeLabel||'none');
  expSet('histActiveObject',active.name||'None');
  const latest=all[0]||null;
  expSet('histLastRecord',latest?histFmtTime(latest.ts):'--');
  expSet('histLastTrial',latest?'Trial 3':'--');
  expSet('histLatestAvg',latest&&latest.mean!==null?fmt(latest.mean,3)+' N':'--');
  expSet('histLatestDate',latest?histFmtDate(latest.ts):'--');
}
function exportHistoryCSV(){
  const rows=historyRowsForCurrentFilter();
  if(!rows.length){alert('Chưa có dữ liệu để export.');return;}
  const header=['No','Object','Time','Date','Trial1_N','Trial2_N','Trial3_N','Avg_N','Error_percent','Repeat_N','ThumbAvg_N','IndexAvg_N','MiddleAvg_N','RingAvg_N','PinkyAvg_N','Status'];
  const lines=[header.join(',')];
  rows.forEach(r=>{
    const meta=expMeta(r.label), f=r.fingerAvg||{}, t=(r.trials||[]).concat(['','','']).slice(0,3);
    const status=Number(r.errPct||0)<=5?'Success':(Number(r.errPct||0)<=10?'Warning':'Error');
    lines.push([r.no,meta.name,histFmtTime(r.ts),histFmtDate(r.ts),...t.map(v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v).toFixed(3):''),r.mean!=null?Number(r.mean).toFixed(3):'',r.errPct!=null?Number(r.errPct).toFixed(2):'',r.rep!=null?Number(r.rep).toFixed(3):'',f.thumb?Number(f.thumb).toFixed(3):'0.000',f.index?Number(f.index).toFixed(3):'0.000',f.middle?Number(f.middle).toFixed(3):'0.000',f.ring?Number(f.ring).toFixed(3):'0.000',f.pinky?Number(f.pinky).toFixed(3):'0.000',status].map(x=>'"'+String(x).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(','));
  });
  const blob=new Blob([lines.join('\n')],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'});
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='DATN_force_history_'+(histFilter||'all')+'.csv';document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
function printHistoryPDF(){
  // Browser print dialog allows "Save as PDF". This is safer than server-side PDF dependencies.
  selectPage('page3',true);
  setTimeout(()=>window.print(),120);
}
function updateExperimentDashboard(d,od,vals,actualGrip,target,gState){
  const label=expCurrentLabel(d,od);
  const meta=expMeta(label);
  const targetN=Number(target||0);
  const hasObj=label!=='none';
  const rec=expEnsure(label,targetN);
  const state=String(d.grip_state||'');
  const palm=Boolean(d.palm_sensor);
  const forceHold=state.includes('FORCE_HOLD') || (gState&&String(gState.txt||'').includes('HOLD'));
  const nowTs=Date.now();

  if(expState.activeLabel!==label){
    expState.activeLabel=label;expState.windowStart=nowTs;expState.samples=[];expState.chartSamples=[];expState.releaseSince=0;
  }

  const forceZero=Number(actualGrip||0)<=0.08;
  if(hasObj && rec && rec.waitingRelease){
    if(forceZero){
      if(!expState.releaseSince)expState.releaseSince=nowTs;
      if(nowTs-expState.releaseSince>=900){
        // Released after a completed grip.  Keep previous numbers on screen,
        // but next grip will replace Trial 1 -> Trial 2 -> Trial 3 progressively.
        rec.nextIndex=0;
        rec.historyLogged=false;
        rec.waitingRelease=false;
        expState.samples=[];
        expState.windowStart=nowTs;
      }
    }else{
      expState.releaseSince=0;
    }
  }

  const openIndex=rec?Math.max(0,Math.min(2,Number(rec.nextIndex||0))):0;
  const hasOpenTrial=Boolean(rec && ((rec.trials||[]).some(v=>!expValidTrial(v)) || Number(rec.nextIndex||0)<3));
  const recordReady=Boolean(hasObj && rec && hasOpenTrial && actualGrip>0.05 && !rec.waitingRelease && (palm || forceHold || state.includes('VISION')));

  if(hasObj){
    expState.chartSamples.push({t:nowTs,total:Number(actualGrip)||0,thumb:Number(vals.thumb||0),index:Number(vals.index||0),middle:Number(vals.middle||0),ring:Number(vals.ring||0),pinky:Number(vals.pinky||0)});
    expState.chartSamples=expState.chartSamples.filter(s=>nowTs-s.t<=EXP_CYCLE_MS);
  }else{
    expState.chartSamples=[];
  }

  if(recordReady){
    expState.samples.push({t:nowTs,v:Number(actualGrip)||0,thumb:Number(vals.thumb||0),index:Number(vals.index||0),middle:Number(vals.middle||0),ring:Number(vals.ring||0),pinky:Number(vals.pinky||0)});
    expState.samples=expState.samples.filter(s=>nowTs-s.t<=EXP_CYCLE_MS);
    if(!expState.windowStart)expState.windowStart=nowTs;
    if(nowTs-expState.windowStart>=EXP_CYCLE_MS){
      const detail=expBuildTrialDetail(expState.samples);
      if(rec && detail.total>0.05){
        const idx=Math.max(0,Math.min(2,Number(rec.nextIndex||0)));
        rec.trials[idx]=detail.total;
        rec.trialDetails[idx]=detail;
        rec.updated=nowTs;
        rec.nextIndex=idx+1;
        if(rec.nextIndex>=3){
          rec.nextIndex=3;
          rec.cycleNo=Number(rec.cycleNo||0)+1;
          rec.historyLogged=false;
          historyAppendFromRecord(label,rec);
        }
        expSave();
      }
      expState.windowStart=nowTs;expState.samples=[];
    }
  }else{
    expState.windowStart=nowTs;expState.samples=[];
  }

  const samples=expState.samples;
  const chartSamples=expState.chartSamples;
  const winAvg=samples.length
    ? samples.reduce((a,b)=>a+Number(b.v||0),0)/samples.length
    : (chartSamples.length?chartSamples.reduce((a,b)=>a+Number(b.total||0),0)/chartSamples.length:actualGrip);
  const currentRec=rec||{target:targetN,trials:[null,null,null],trialDetails:[null,null,null],nextIndex:0};
  const st=expStats(currentRec);
  const nextTrialIndex=rec?Math.max(0,Math.min(2,Number(rec.nextIndex||0))):0;
  const nextTrial=nextTrialIndex+1;
  const elapsed=recordReady?(Date.now()-expState.windowStart):0;
  const remain=Math.max(0,Math.ceil((EXP_CYCLE_MS-elapsed)/1000));
  const statusTxt=!hasObj?'WAIT OBJECT':(rec&&rec.waitingRelease?'WAIT RELEASE':(recordReady?'MEASURING':(st.count>=3?'COMPLETE':'WAIT CONTACT')));

  expSet('expObjectName',meta.name);
  expSet('expObjectTitle',meta.name);
  expSetVisual('expObjectIcon',meta);
  expSet('expTrialIndex',hasObj?`${Math.min((rec?Number(rec.nextIndex||0):0)+1,3)} / 3`:'0 / 3');
  expSet('expCycleSec','10 s');
  expSet('expState',statusTxt,statusTxt==='MEASURING'?'green-t':(statusTxt==='COMPLETE'?'green-t':'amber-t'));
  expSet('expCountdown',`${String(remain).padStart(2,'0')} s`);
  expLamp('expObjectLamp',hasObj);
  expLamp('expPalmLamp',palm);
  expLamp('expForceLamp',forceHold);
  expLamp('expRecordLamp',recordReady,recordReady&&!forceHold);

  [1,2,3].forEach(i=>{
    const val=currentRec.trials[i-1];
    expSet(`expTrial${i}`,expValidTrial(val)?fmt(val,2)+' N':'--');
    const sub=expValidTrial(val)?'Recorded':(i===nextTrial&&recordReady?'Recording':'Waiting');
    expSet(`expTrial${i}Sub`,sub);
    const card=$(`expTrialCard${i}`); if(card)card.classList.toggle('active',i===nextTrial&&recordReady);
  });
  expSet('expTarget',targetN>0?fmt(targetN,2)+' N':'--');
  expSet('expMean',st.mean!==null?fmt(st.mean,2)+' N':'--',st.mean!==null?'green-t':'');
  expSet('expErrN',st.err!==null?fmt(st.err,2)+' N':'--',st.err!==null?'amber-t':'');
  expSet('expErrPct',st.errPct!==null?fmt(st.errPct,2)+'%':'--',st.errPct!==null?'amber-t':'');
  expSet('expRepeat',st.rep!==null?fmt(st.rep,2)+' N':'--','cyan-t');
  expSet('expEval',st.eval,st.eval==='OK'?'green-t':(st.eval==='NG'?'red-t':(st.eval==='CHECK'?'amber-t':'')));
  expSet('expWinAvg',fmt(winAvg,2));
  expSet('expTargetSide',fmt(targetN,2));
  const nowErr=targetN>0?winAvg-targetN:0;
  expSet('expNowErr',(nowErr>=0?'+':'')+fmt(nowErr,2));
  expSet('expNowErrPct',targetN>0?fmt(Math.abs(nowErr)/targetN*100,2):'0.00');
  expSet('expThumbNow',fmt(vals.thumb||0,2));
  expSet('expIndexNow',fmt(vals.index||0,2));
  expSet('expMiddleNow',fmt(vals.middle||0,2));
  expSet('expRingNow',fmt(vals.ring||0,2));
  expSet('expPinkyNow',fmt(vals.pinky||0,2));
  expSet('expLastUpdate',new Date().toLocaleString('en-GB'));
  expUpdateRows();
  if(currentPage==='page3')renderHistoryPage();
  drawExpChart(targetN);
}
function updateControlsFromStatus(d){
  controlMode=String(d.mode||controlMode||'AUTO').toUpperCase();
  renderMode();
  fingers.forEach(([k])=>{
    // Auto bars display UNITY/ROBOT command percent, so it matches Unity UI better.
    const unityVal=Number(d['unity_'+k+'_pct']);
    const autoVal=Number(d['auto_'+k+'_pct']);
    const shown=Number.isFinite(unityVal)?unityVal:autoVal;
    if($('auto_'+k))$('auto_'+k).textContent=Math.round(shown||0);
    bar('auto_'+k+'_bar',shown||0,100,k==='pinky');

    const hand=Number(d['hand_'+k+'_pct']||0);
    const uni=Number.isFinite(unityVal)?unityVal:(shown||0);
    const err=Math.abs(hand-uni);

    if($('hand_'+k))$('hand_'+k).textContent=Math.round(hand);
    if($('unity_'+k))$('unity_'+k).textContent=Math.round(uni);
    if($('err_'+k))$('err_'+k).textContent=fmt(err,1)+'°';

    const serverM=Number(d['manual_'+k+'_pct']);
    if(Number.isFinite(serverM)&&document.activeElement!==$('man_'+k)){
      manual[k]=serverM;
      if($('man_'+k))$('man_'+k).value=String(Math.round(serverM));
      if($('man_'+k+'_val'))$('man_'+k+'_val').textContent=Math.round(serverM)+'%';
    }
  })
}

class _DashboardHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "DATNDashboardV40PulsePanelBelow/37.0"

    def _send_bytes(self, code: int, data: bytes, content_type: str) -> None:
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", content_type)
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0")
        self.send_header("Pragma", "no-cache")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]

        if path in ("/", "/index.html"):
            self._send_bytes(200, HTML_PAGE.encode("utf-8"), "text/html; charset=utf-8")
            return


        if path == "/api/logo/school":
            data, content_type = get_logo_response("school")
            self._send_bytes(200, data, content_type)
            return

        if path == "/api/logo/faculty":
            data, content_type = get_logo_response("faculty")
            self._send_bytes(200, data, content_type)
            return

        if path == "/api/status":
            data = json.dumps(get_dashboard_snapshot(), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
            self._send_bytes(200, data, "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            return

        if path == "/api/control":
            data = json.dumps(get_web_control_snapshot(), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
            self._send_bytes(200, data, "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            return

        if path == "/api/camera/main":
            data, content_type = get_camera_response("main")
            self._send_bytes(200, data, content_type)
            return

        if path == "/api/camera/phone":
            data, content_type = get_camera_response("phone")
            self._send_bytes(200, data, content_type)
            return

        self._send_bytes(404, b"Not Found", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")


    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
        if path == "/api/control":
            try:
                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0") or "0")
                raw = self.rfile.read(length) if length > 0 else b"{}"
                payload = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore") or "{}")
                if isinstance(payload, dict):
                    update_web_control(**payload)
                data = json.dumps(get_web_control_snapshot(), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
                self._send_bytes(200, data, "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            except Exception as e:
                data = json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": str(e)}, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
                self._send_bytes(500, data, "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            return
        self._send_bytes(404, b"Not Found", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")

    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        # Khong in log moi request /api/status de terminal gon.
        return


def start_web_dashboard(host: str = "0.0.0.0", port: int = 5000, print_link: bool = True, open_browser: bool = False, public: bool = False, ngrok_path: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    """
    Khoi dong web dashboard o thread rieng.
    Goi 1 lan khi chuong trinh Python bat dau.

    open_browser=True: tu mo tab web tren laptop khi chay code Python chinh.
    public=True: tu bat ngrok de tao link public gui cho nguoi khac khac mang.
    ngrok_path="D:/ngrok/ngrok.exe": chi ro vi tri ngrok.exe neu khong co trong PATH.
    """
    global _SERVER, _SERVER_THREAD

    links = get_access_links(port)

    if _SERVER is not None:
        return links["lan"]

    _SERVER = ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), _DashboardHandler)
    _SERVER_THREAD = threading.Thread(target=_SERVER.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    _SERVER_THREAD.start()

    if print_link:
        print("=" * 86)
        print("[DATN WEB V9] Dashboard da chay.")
        print(f"[DATN WEB V9] Laptop local:        {links['local']}")
        print(f"[DATN WEB V9] Ten may Windows:     {links['hostname']}")
        print(f"[DATN WEB V9] Thu them .local:      {links['hostname_local']}")
        print(f"[DATN WEB V9] Dien thoai cung Wi-Fi:{links['lan']}")
        print(f"[DATN WEB V9] Host name: {links['host_name']} | LAN/IP detect: {links['lan_ip']}")
        print("[DATN WEB V9] Camera endpoints: /api/camera/main va /api/camera/phone")
        print("=" * 86)

    if public:
        start_public_tunnel_ngrok(port=port, ngrok_path=ngrok_path, print_link=print_link)

    if open_browser:
        try:
            webbrowser.open(links["local"])
        except Exception:
            pass

    return links["lan"]


def stop_web_dashboard() -> None:
    global _SERVER, _SERVER_THREAD, _NGROK_PROCESS, _NGROK_PUBLIC_URL

    if _NGROK_PROCESS is not None:
        try:
            _NGROK_PROCESS.terminate()
        except Exception:
            pass
        _NGROK_PROCESS = None
        _NGROK_PUBLIC_URL = None

    if _SERVER is not None:
        _SERVER.shutdown()
        _SERVER.server_close()
        _SERVER = None
        _SERVER_THREAD = None


if __name__ == "__main__":
    """
    Demo doc lap de test giao dien V5.
    Khi gan vao code chinh thi khong can phan demo nay.
    """
    import sys

    # Chay LAN nhu cu:
    #     python datn_web_dashboard_public.py
    #
    # Chay public link cho ban ngoai mang:
    #     python datn_web_dashboard_public.py --public
    #
    # Neu ngrok.exe khong nam trong PATH, dat bien moi truong NGROK_PATH
    # hoac sua ngrok_path ben duoi, vi du:
    #     start_web_dashboard(port=5000, public=True, ngrok_path=r"D:\ngrok\ngrok.exe")
    public_mode = any(arg.lower() in ("--public", "public", "--ngrok", "ngrok") for arg in sys.argv[1:])
    start_web_dashboard(port=5000, public=public_mode)

    labels = [
        ("none", "None", 0),
        ("kimquat_sauce", "Kimquat Sauce", 200),
        ("red_chili", "Red Chili", 80),
        ("orange", "Orange", 150),
    ]

    states = [
        "FREE_TRACKING_AUTO",
        "OBJECT_LOCKED_WAIT_PALM",
        "VISION_GRIP_CLOSING_AUTO",
        "FORCE_HOLD",
    ]

    i = 0
    try:
        while True:
            label, name, mass = labels[(i // 85) % len(labels)]
            state = states[(i // 52) % len(states)]
            t = time.time()

            base = 4.7 + 3.7 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 1.15))
            palm = state in ("VISION_GRIP_CLOSING_AUTO", "FORCE_HOLD")

            def noise(v: float) -> float:
                return max(0.0, v + random.uniform(-0.22, 0.22))

            update_dashboard(
                object_label=label,
                object_name=name,
                mass_g=mass,
                grip_state=state,
                palm_sensor=palm,
                palm_test=((i // 130) % 2 == 1),
                loadcell_n=mass / 1000.0 * 9.81,
                required_min_n=max(0.0, base - 1.5),
                required_max_n=base + 1.5,
                target_total_n=base,
                fps=23.8 + random.uniform(-1.1, 1.1),
                esp32_status="Connected",
                unity_status="UDP 5052/5053 OK",
                serial_note="DEMO MODE",
                mode="AUTO",
                auto_state="RUNNING",
                camera_status="Active",
                yolo_status="Ready",
                hand_status="Tracking",
                fsr_index_n=noise(base * 0.22),
                fsr_middle_n=noise(base * 0.27),
                fsr_ring_n=noise(base * 0.19),
                fsr_pinky_n=noise(base * 0.18),
            )

            # Demo camera frame cho web khi chay rieng file dashboard.
            try:
                import cv2
                import numpy as np
                demo_main = np.zeros((540, 960, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
                demo_phone = np.zeros((540, 960, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
                demo_main[:] = (18, 24, 36)
                demo_phone[:] = (24, 18, 32)
                cv2.putText(demo_main, "MAIN CAMERA - YOLO DEMO", (55, 80), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 1.2, (0, 220, 255), 3)
                cv2.putText(demo_main, f"Object: {name}", (55, 145), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 1.0, (220, 255, 255), 2)
                cv2.rectangle(demo_main, (310, 170), (650, 430), (0, 255, 180), 4)
                cv2.putText(demo_main, label, (310, 158), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.8, (0, 255, 180), 2)
                cv2.putText(demo_phone, "PHONE CAMERA - SECONDARY VIEW", (55, 80), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 1.2, (255, 170, 80), 3)
                cv2.putText(demo_phone, f"Grip State: {state}", (55, 145), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.85, (220, 255, 255), 2)
                cv2.circle(demo_phone, (480, 300), 90, (255, 160, 60), 4)
                update_camera_frame("main", demo_main)
                update_camera_frame("phone", demo_phone)
            except Exception:
                pass

            i += 1
            time.sleep(0.1)

    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        stop_web_dashboard()
        print("\n[DONE]")
